title: Time-of-Use Import Cost by Tariff Window
app: Tesla Powerwall, Enphase IQ, SolarEdge, Sense, Emporia Vue, DSMR / P1 smart meters, and utility tariff exports collected via vendor APIs, Home Assistant, MQTT, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=dsmr:telegram
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| eval tariff_window=case(hour>=16 AND hour<21,"peak",hour>=21 OR hour<7,"offpeak",true(),"shoulder")
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(import_kwh) as import_kwh by tariff_window _time
| sort - _time tariff_window
description: Uses DSMR smart-meter telemetry telemetry to monitor daily import broken out by tariff window in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for when expensive windows are carrying too much load, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest DSMR smart-meter telemetry data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
visualization: Daily tariff-window chart of imported kWh.
grandmaExplanation: It totals daily import broken out by tariff window so you can spot when expensive windows are carrying too much load before it becomes annoying.
